_comment: PUBLIC ROADMAP CONTENT. Every entry here is a §6 truthfulness claim, not a status label —
a customer reads 'Shipped' as 'I can use this today'. Verify before moving anything.
The bar used for this file, applied to every entry on 2026-07-30:
shipped  = merged AND every dependency it needs at runtime is live. For anything that
reads Tinybird that means the pipe is DEPLOYED (founder-gated, so merged does
not imply deployed). For anything reading a new Supabase column it means the
building = code exists but a customer cannot get a correct result from it yet.
soon     = committed and scoped, not started. Deliberately empty rather than padded.
Two entries were demoted from 'shipped' to 'building' by that bar — see `verified_note`
on each. Do not promote them back without re-checking the named condition.

items.title: GA4 + TikTok CAPI
items.description: Server-side conversion forwarding to Google Analytics 4 Measurement Protocol and the TikTok Events API, alongside the existing Meta, Google Ads, Microsoft and LinkedIn senders.
items.verified_note: Both senders are in the dispatchCapi fan-out, and the ga4_/tiktok_ columns they read are applied on prod.

items.title: Leads by source and campaign
items.description: Lead volume aggregated by acquisition source and campaign, not just a lead-by-lead list.
items.verified_note: leads_count, leads_list and flexible_report_campaign_leads_by_site are all deployed.

items.title: Funnels
items.description: Multi-step path funnels with per-step drop-off. When a date range is too large to read completely, the funnel now says so instead of quietly reporting on a partial dataset.
items.verified_note: Depends on the summary pipe, which is deployed. Truncation honesty merged.

items.title: Conversion delivery log
items.description: Per-platform delivery history for server-side conversions — what was sent, what the platform answered, and what failed.
items.verified_note: Reads Supabase, no pipe dependency. Rendered on Setup & Health.

columns.title: Building
columns.description: Written and merged, not yet giving customers a correct answer.

items.title: AI visibility
items.description: Which AI crawlers and assistants fetch your pages — GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and others — with honest per-hit verification rather than trusting a user agent that anyone can spoof.
items.note: Detection and reporting are merged. The data store behind the report is not live yet, so it would show an empty state today.
items.verified_note: Verified 2026-07-30: the crawler_hits datasource and both crawler_* pipes are absent from the workspace (3 datasources, 435 endpoints, zero crawler_*). Move to shipped only once those are deployed AND a real hit has landed.

items.title: MCP diagnostic tools
items.description: Ask Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT about your SourceTrack setup — workspace context, site health, data quality, data flow and event verification — over the Model Context Protocol, read-only.
items.note: Merged and tested, but no one has run it against a live key yet. It stays here until a real end-to-end call has succeeded.
items.verified_note: First enforcement of the read:analytics scope, and api_keys is 0 rows in prod — so the auth path has never been exercised by a real key. Move to shipped after one successful real-key call.

columns.title: Coming soon
columns.empty_state: Nothing queued publicly right now. We list work here once it is scoped and committed — not to fill a column.
